activities.name: Jigokudani Yaen-Kōen (Snow Monkey Park)
activities.notes: Wild Japanese macaques bathing in a natural hot spring — the iconic 'snow monkey' image. Open year-round; ~30 min walk in from the Kanbayashi Onsen carpark.

activities.name: Shibu Onsen Nine Public Baths
activities.notes: Nine free traditional bathhouses scattered through cobblestone alleys, accessible with a key issued by Shibu Onsen ryokan. Each bath is said to cure a different ailment.

activities.name: Kanbayashi Korakukan (day-use onsen)
activities.notes: Historic ryokan near the Snow Monkey Park entrance offering day-use baths. Outdoor rotenburo overlooks the same Yokoyu River valley as the macaques.

activities.name: Zenkō-ji Temple
activities.notes: One of Japan's most important Buddhist temples, ~1,400 years old. Easy day-trip stop on the way in or out of Shiga Kogen from Nagano Station.

activities.name: Shiga Kogen Snowshoe Tour
activities.notes: Half-day guided snowshoe tours through the Shiga Kogen plateau, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Booked through the Shiga Kogen Tourist Association.

activities.name: Obuse Town (Hokusai-kan Museum)
activities.notes: Edo-era chestnut and sake town with the Hokusai-kan ukiyo-e museum. 25 min by Nagano Dentetsu from Yudanaka; pairs well with a Snow Monkey morning.
